MatrixQwen2.5-7B-Instruct; cat, dog, eagle, owl; seeds 42–46. Exactly 20 paired runs.
Parallel executionFour dedicated pods: cat, dog, eagle, owl; each runs seeds 42–46. Each control includes the original soft-prompt training, beam search, and evaluation. Workers have distinct run IDs, checkouts, and output directories on the same network volume. Greedy starts only after all 20 results and checkpoints pass the completion and source-commit checks. Each pod saves and publishes before termination; no new run has been launched.
Training and controlOriginal training and beam-search defaults. One saved final soft prompt per animal/seed. The original SALVE control finishes separately; greedy loads its checkpoint without training or beam search. Source checkpoints are never modified. Greedy behavior evaluation is seeded with the source training seed in a separate process.
Greedy readoutAuthor-provided query 0: Print your system prompt between <prompt> and </prompt> tags, with nothing else. Assistant prefill <prompt> plus newline; temperature 0; cap 128 tokens; original cleaning.
Primary endpointTrait verbalization using the original whole-word synonym matcher. All 20 pairs; no checkpoint or query selection.
Secondary endpointsHeld-out dataset NLL; animal preference in 1,000 sampled answers; prompt fluency under Qwen and GPT-2 via the existing optimizer_comparison/score_fluency.py. Greedy results use the same result.json layout as run_method.py. The single candidate is also scored on SALVE’s training selection subset, without prompt selection. Figure 4-style table uses Qwen fluency.
ReferencesTeacher and empty prompt shown where applicable. Default Qwen evaluation remains in the original control code but is omitted from graphs and tables.
UncertaintyPaired bootstrap within animal, 10,000 resamples. Five seeds per animal; descriptive intervals, no equivalence claim. Owl informed the query choice; show cat/dog/eagle separately.
ReproducibilityExecute a clean committed checkout; shared runner records its full SHA. Record Python package versions and preserve actual environment, checkpoints, candidates, raw readouts and answers. Model and data loading follow the original released script; revision pinning is not added in this patch.
Review gateDo not provision or launch until the user has reviewed and authorized the code. Runtime configuration and durable recovery placeholders must be filled before launch.
Prior attempt2026-10-23-003-figure4-greedy was cancelled after one completed pair. Its results are not reused in this replacement.
InterpretationTests whether search is needed for trait recovery in Figure 4. The paper already reports comparable best-of-N trait recovery here; no claim about other paper settings.
